obs_normalization.source: confirmed: no normalizer tensors in this checkpoint -- trained with empirical_normalization=False, raw observations fed directly to the policy (unchanged from asimov1_omni_quality_run2_validated).

reward_shape_lineage: Isaac-Asimov1-Velocity-AMP-v0 -- resumed from asimov1_omni_quality_run2_validated (iteration 26982) for 1500 more iterations (28482 total). NO reward-shape changes -- the actual change was fixing a reset-distribution blind spot in EventCfg.reset_robot_joints: mdp.reset_joints_by_scale multiplies each joint's DEFAULT position by a random factor, but this robot's AMP bent-knee init pose parks hip_roll/hip_yaw/ankle_roll/shoulder_yaw/wrist_yaw at exactly 0.0, so those joints NEVER varied across this policy's entire training history (0 * anything = 0) -- exactly the joints governing lateral balance/foot placement. Added 3 new additive EventTerms (reset_hip_asymmetry, reset_ankle_roll_asymmetry, reset_arm_yaw_asymmetry, via mdp.reset_joints_by_offset) so those joints finally get real startup-pose variation too. Also fixed an unrelated pre-existing bug found while isolation-testing this resume: asimov1/mdp.py's InsufficientProgressTermination was missing a `return` statement (dormant since Oct 15, never triggered because no velocity-task training had run since).
notes: Measured effect on the policy-stitching phase-machine demo (walk->fall->recover->walk, chaining this checkpoint with a fall-recovery checkpoint): the standalone walking quality visibly improved live (user: 'falls only seldomly'), training metrics stayed healthy throughout (reward stable ~30-37, no collapse), but the specific RECOVER->WALK handoff success rate was measured FLAT (65.4% vs. 65.7% baseline) -- this fix alone did not move that number. The real gains in handoff success (eventually 65.7% -> 88.0%) came entirely from retraining the FALL-RECOVERY policy, not this one. Kept as the walking half of the best validated phase-stitch pairing regardless, since the underlying robustness fix is real and the walking quality genuinely improved.
